sentences.text:
Coram : Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Sanjay Kumar Dwivedi
------
For the Petitioner : Mr. Saurabh Shekhar, Advocate.

For the State : Mr. Ashish Kumar, A.C. to
G.A.-Ii.
------
03/ 13.12.2022
Learned counsel appearing for the petitioner submits that in lodging the FIR, the provision under Section 42 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 has not been followed.
He submits that without following the due procedure, the premises of the petitioner have been sealed.
He further submits that consumable items are sealed in the godown and factory of the petitioner.
In view of such submission, respondent-State is directed to take instruction and file counter affidavit in the matter within two weeks.

No coercive steps shall be taken against the petitioner, in connection with Mahagama P.S. Case No.
222 of 2022, pending in the court of learned Judicial Magistrate, 1st Class, Godda, till the next date of listing.

(Sanjay Kumar Dwivedi, J.) Amitesh/-
